steps.en: Settled notices (paid/cancelled) are excluded from the batch
steps.id: Notice yang sudah selesai (paid/cancelled) dikeluarkan dari batch
steps.why_en: No batch selection exists; only an unrelated payment cutoff job.
steps.why_id: Belum ada seleksi batch; hanya job cutoff bayar yang tidak terkait.

steps.why_en: Only a data type exists; no memo is generated.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada tipe data; memo tidak dibuat.

steps.en: The court summonses are available to merge
steps.why_en: No summons is generated by the system.

steps.en: The charge sheets are available to merge
steps.why_en: No charge sheet is generated by the system.
steps.why_id: Charge sheet tidak dibuat oleh sistem.

steps.en: Memo, summons and charge sheet are merged into one viewable, downloadable PDF
steps.id: Memo, summons, dan charge sheet digabung jadi satu PDF yang bisa dilihat dan diunduh
steps.why_en: No merging or viewing of court PDFs is built.
steps.why_id: Penggabungan dan tampilan PDF court belum dibuat.

steps.en: The merged PDF is sent to the vendor for printing and postage
steps.id: PDF gabungan dikirim ke vendor untuk cetak dan pos
steps.why_en: The vendor link exists only for reminder letters and is off in production config.
steps.why_id: Jalur ke vendor hanya untuk surat reminder dan dimatikan di konfigurasi produksi.
